articleTitle: Remote Controlling Distributed Parallel Computing System over the Cloud (RCDPCSC)
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: Parallel Distributed Processing approaches are relatively new. A distributed cloud is the application of cloud computing technologies to interconnect data and applications served from multiple geographic locations. A distributed information technology (IT) means that something is shared among multiple systems that may also be in the same or different locations. The amount of data and exhausted time to process them and regulate the expected results efficiently and in as lowest as possible time has been expanded enormous. Therefore, it is essential to prepare approaches to enhance parallel processing techniques via cloud computing.

articleTitle: An Overview on V2P Communication System: Architecture and Application
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: Road traffic accident management is very complex and sensitive issue. Recently, more attention has delivered to research in Vehicle-to-Pedestrian (V2P) communication systems, which function for different purposes such as safety or convenience and cater to different Vulnerable Road User (VRU) groups. This paper gives a brief overview for vehicle-to-pedestrian system with focusing on different communication technologies that V2P system employ it and the different mechanisms to interact with the users. The varying characteristics of different communication architecture and applications needs to be considered in an effective V2P system. Therefore, in the field of intelligent transportation research, there is the task of improving the road user safety such as, pedestrian through the development of technological tools, which can apply to reduce the number of accidents.

articleTitle: Classification of Vegetative pests for cucumber plants using artificial neural networks
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: One of the topics that occupies many articles is the improvement of medical diagnostic processes, where many articles have begun to elicit algorithms to increase the efficiency of disease diagnosis, presented in this article a method for diagnosing plant diseases based on digital image processing techniques and neural networks.

articleTitle: Design a Tracing System for a Seed Supply Chain Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: Blockchain technology performs a process of storing inside a record, and this ledger is raised on a large number of parties (computers, servers). Records are encrypted and cannot be tampered with, as happens in centralized systems. In order to solve the problem of manipulating or modifying information and knowledge of the origin of the product and increasing the consumer's transparency of the product coming from a series of the supply chain, this research suggests building a system to tracing the product. All product information is stored in serial blockchain through an algorithm that organizes the work of each part of the supply chain and the information it stores. Also, an algorithm to retrieve product information by searching for Blockchain. The results are expected to be important in terms of increased food security and increased competition between distributors. The entire purpose behind supply chain the management and coordination are to give customers the level and nature of administration that they require and to do as such at less expense to the complete supply chain. Traceability is a big necessity in supply chain ventures, particularly for the agri-food industry. Building a product tracking system in a supply chain to enable the consumer and government agencies to track and know the source and origin of the product in an easy, safe and reliable way from tampering and provide the fixed system the just manager can approve accepted users that be trusted people because will add data that all world will see it for that in the system, we build an algorithm to generate the activation key for adding a client.

articleTitle: Security Enhancement of AES-CBC and its Performance Evaluation Using the Avalanche Effect
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: The security of communication systems is becoming a significant concern with the increase in computational power. High-security cryptographic algorithms are required to protect the privacy of information from unauthorized access. This paper presents a security enhancement of Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) in Cipher Block Chaining (CBC) mode and its performance evaluation using the Avalanche Effect. In this study, a new improved technique for increasing the security of the AES-CBC is introduced. The Unix time is used as a source for Initialization Vector (IV) in CBC mode before encryption rounds. The results showed that the algorithm generates different ciphertext at each execution. In other words, different ciphertext output significantly decreases the risk of cracking the encryption key. Moreover, the results are examined using the Avalanche Effect and tested for satisfying the security criteria. The achieved results showed that the encryption method succeeds in maintaining the avalanche effect requirement and introducing additional strength to the encryption process by preventing the encryption key update for every new ciphertext.

articleTitle: An overview of the Survey/Review Studies in Wireless Body Area Network
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: Thanks to the advances in electronics, wireless communications, sensing technology, and micro-electro-mechanical systems (MEMS) that have enabled the development of small, low-power sensors and actuators that can be placed on, in, or around the human body. A wireless body area network (WBAN) can be effectively used to deliver the sensory data to a central server or on the body coordinator node, where it can be monitored, stored, and analyzed. In this paper, an overview of the available studies on WBAN that has been done so far.

articleTitle: Analysis of Novel Seven-Dimension Hyper Chaotic by Using SDIC and Waveform
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: In this paper, a proposed novel seven dimensions (7D) hyperchaotic system with twelve positive parameters is presented. A chaotic behavior for the proposed system is proved through zero-one test, waveform analysis, Sensitivity Dependent on Initial Condition (SDIC) analysis and Lyapunov exponent. It is well known that one of the chaotic definitions is the proposed system is chaotic if it has positive Lyapunov exponent or it satisfies SDIC on its domain and it is known that the waveform analysis is an indication of the chaotic novel 7D system. It was approved that a little change in the initial values creates a high sensitivity in the chaotic behavior when the period time becomes large because the distance between initial conditions will become large. The dynamics of the novel 7D hyperchaotic simulated using the Mathematica program. Testing results show that the proposed system is hyperchaotic because it has three Lyapunov positive exponent, the time-domain waveform has non-cyclical characteristics and it has a better sensitivity dependent on initial condition on initial values.

articleTitle: Improved Intrusion Detection Accuracy Based on Optimization Fast Learning Network Model
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: In current days, accuracy of Intrusion detection system still represents one of main limitation of the system. Moreover, hybrid model based on intrusion detection system achieved better results in compared with model based single algorithm. This work presents a new intrusion detection system based on hybrid model based on Fast Learning Network (FLN) and Genetic Algorithm (GA) which called (GA-FLN), NSL-KDD dataset used to evaluate the proposed model. The results of new model represent with different numbers of hidden neurons to analysis the impact of neurons based on accuracy of intrusion detection system.

articleTitle: A Proposed Image Compression Technique Based on DWT and Predictive Techniques
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: The idea behind the suggested developed image compression system depends on the application of DWT on error prediction values (Residual Image) instead of the original image. The error prediction values have simpler values compared to the original image, to reduce the coefficient values of all the wavelet bands. As a result, the detail bands can overcome for the first decomposition level and all / some of detail bands for the second decomposition level. In addition, the effect of quantization process is less. The system has been applied on the natural and gray-scale images. The results obtained was similar for both image types. Seven types of different wavelet for four families were compared: {dbl, db3, db5, syml, coifl, bior 2.2, bi02.4.}. The db3 wavelet produced the best (PSNR), which nearest from Coifl wavelet.

articleTitle: Performance Measurement of Processes and Threads Controlling, Tracking and Monitoring Based on Shared-Memory Parallel Processing Approach
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: In this paper, a professional integrated operating system performance measurement system is proposed, designed, and implemented in order to monitor processes and threads. Because monitoring itself is not enough, so this system provides full control of the CPU forcing, Priority-changing, and pausing-resuming-killing of these processes/threads. During these complex operations, it provides the ability to measure/compute the details of Total-execution-time, CPU-time, User-time, Kernel-time, context switching, CPU -usage, and the priority of processes/threads. The proposed system can be used with any architecture of multicore processors. Despite that measuring all these parameters in one system is very difficult and complex especially the Kernel-time and Context-switching, but all of them have been applied and determined successfully. Adding to the above features that never been integrated (by any previous work) in one system, and in order to illustrate the real abilities of this system, a shared-memory parallel processing approach has been proposed and applied. The proposed system prepared to run all possible cases of processes and threads that construct under-tested-program which may be one of the: Single-Process-Single-Thread, Single-Process-Multi- Thread, Multi-Process-Single-Thread, Multi-Process-Multi- Thread, and Multi- Process-Single-Multi-Thread. The algorithms of this system are designed and implemented via C++ programming language(using C++ Standard Library Thread) which is the nearest programming to the OSs provides a more increasing processing speed.

articleTitle: Application of DBSCAN to Anomaly Detection in Airport Terminals
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: Early identification of abnormal flight conditions is extremely critical in terms of safety precautions and preventing possible incidents. Because there is a massive amount of raw data streaming daily via the ADS-B to Flightradar24, which often approaches hundreds of millions, dealing with such unorganized details and identifying abnormal cases is extremely difficult. In this paper, the DBSCAN algorithm proposes to analyze and identify unknown events within routine flight data without previous knowledge of historical flight data. DBSCAN does not need a complex configuration or consumes a significant amount of time to implement, but rather relies on the appropriate selection of features and also on the particular threshold (ε), The algorithm analyzed three dataset types for Najaf International Airport consisting of 41 B738 flights (DXB), 39 B738 flights (IST), and 29 A310 flights (IKA). The percentage of anomalies in these airlines was as follows: Fly Dubai 1.32 percent, Istanbul Airlines 0.32 percent, while Iranian Airlines recorded the highest anomalies at 1.66 percent. The results of these analyzes must be made available to airspace experts and pilots to assess the value of safety risks.

articleTitle: A Review on Vehicle-to-Infrastructure Communication System: Requirement and Applications
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: The field of vehicular communication technology is rapidly developing. vehicular communication technologies provide great social benefits such as reduced road accident and increased road efficiency. To improve traffic safety and provide drivers with the best end-to-end transportation experience, vehicles need to be more automated which is the most important goals of modern vehicular communication technologies. Utilizing Vehicle-to- Infrastructure communication (V2I) may be a keystone to enhance and promote the various vehicular communications applications. By the exchange of information between vehicles and road infrastructures, drivers will have more ability to predict and avoid various road hazard and thus make driving experience much safer. In this paper, we will focus on the study of the main requirement and component in V2I systems and present a review of the major V2I benefits related to safety and mobility applications.

articleTitle: Status and Challenges of Frequent Itemsets and Association Rules Mining Methods
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: Extracting frequent itemsets and association rules mining very important field in data mining applications. It is very useful for support making strategy decisions for any organization or company. As well as, there is very close relationship between frequent itemsets and association rules mining, where extracting frequent itemsets is originally one of the two main procedures for creating association rules. In this paper we introduce first, study of more important parameters for frequent itemsets as well as association rules mining. After that we present classification of more popular types of frequent itemsets and association rules mining.

articleTitle: Accessing the Best Path Using Dijkstra Algorithm & GIS for Mobile Cloud Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: Due to criminal cases and its negative aspects on citizens lives and health, for example, causing severe injuries, transitional or epidemic diseases, and other matters related to the health sector. All of these problems require immediate solutions and quick reactions from the concerned authorities, but some obstacles cause obstruction of these solutions, for example when a problem or an accident occurs in a specific place such as a kidnapping accident, it is difficult for the concerned authorities to reach the accident site with the required accuracy and time required This means taking a short and expressway to arrive in time to resolve the problem. In this paper, and to solve such problems, we propose a system by which the shortest path on the map can be determined using the program (QGIS) and the (Dijkstra) algorithm to determine the shortest path between the accident sites and the nearest point where the officials of the relevant authorities are present.

articleTitle: Optimizing Roadside via Unit Deployment Mechanism in V ANET
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: The vehicular ad hoc network (VANET), combined with the distribution of roadside units (RSUs), play a significant role in reducing accidents and traffic jams by sending warning and emergency messages to drivers in real-time. However, communication is not always available owing to the lack of RSUs. Therefore, in this paper, we have proposed a new strategy for the deployment of the least possible number of RSUs by developing a support protocol in case of loss of communication that relies on smartphones until the connection returns. The simulation results show that the proposed distribution method clearly reduces the number of RSUs required (compared to existing methods), and contributes towards increased coverage, reduced costs, and less missing data.

articleTitle: Mamdani FIS Combined With LU Decomposition Method and Two-Level LWT for Image Watermarking Technique
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: Fuzzy theory and linear algebra have a substantial role in various sciences and the biggest effect was in the share of computer science. In the field of image processing, the process of digital image watermarking represents the inclusion of a secret logo or an image called watermark into a host image to get a watermarked image to guarantee copyright protection or ownership. The watermarking will be acceptable if it achieves specific qualities like imperceptibility and robustness. In this paper, Mamdani fuzzy inference system (FIS) was employed on the original image for obtaining the controller parameter which works on finding a trade-off between imperceptibility and robustness, and on the other hand, is combined with the algebraic matrix decomposition method LU for proposing a digital watermarking technique in which the watermark is included in the LH2 band produced by applying two-level of the lifting wavelet transform (LWT) using the modular arithmetic (mod). The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm resistant to many attacks.

articleTitle: Testing Mechanical Behaviour of Bone-Plate Construct
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: Metal plates are widely used to treat bone fractures operationally. Rigid metal plates support the fracture site and allow early weight-bearing and mobility for patients. This paper aims to compare the experimental work with the analysis of finite elements for bone plates used to heal femoral fractures according to their effects on the bone and fracture site and to compare their behaviors under the compression condition that is created while the patient (70 kg weight) is standing up. Firstly, this study is intended to assist surgeons in determining where to position the screws to achieve optimal fracture fixation; secondly to state the amount of deformation created after fixation of the bone fracture under the body mass. This paper has been focused on the analysis of bone-plate construct as a transverse fracture of femur bone fixed with Dynamic Compression Plate (DCP) of 16 holes and Cortex screws 4.5. To study the effects of the positioning of the screws on the mechanical behavior for different screws arrangements. This work contains experiential work and finite element analysis (FEA) Simulation. Concerning the experimental work compression test is conducted by a Testometric device to validate the FEA results. The results state the relationships between the total deformation and the plate working length according to three different screws distribution patterns SDPs. The study shows the regions of maximum deformation and stress, also shows the difference in results of cylindrical and anatomical bone models used in the majority of researches.

articleTitle: Distributed Transform Encoder to Improve Diffie-Hellman Protocol for Big Message Security
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: Man in the middle Attack (MIMA) problem of Diffie-Hellman key exchange (D-H) protocol, has led to introduce the Hash Diffie-Hellman key exchange (H-D-H) protocol. Which was cracked by applying the brute force attack (BFA) results of hash function. For this paper, a system will be suggested that focusses on an improved key exchange (D-H) protocol, and distributed transform encoder (DTE). That system utilized for enhanced (D-H) protocol algorithm when (D-H) is applied for generating the keys used for encrypting data of long messages. Hash256, with two secret keys and one public key are used for D-H protocol improvements. Finally, DTE where applied, this cryptosystem led to increase the efficiency of data transfer security with strengthening the shared secret key code. Also, it has removed the important problems such as MITM and BFA, as compared to the previous work.

articleTitle: Flexural Behavior and Sustainability Analysis of Hollow-core R.C. One-way Slabs
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: Using the recycled plastic pipes to make longitudinal voids in the hollow-core slab (HCS) is a very effective method to eliminate approximately 33 % of the concrete volume of the hollow-core slabs which leads to decrease the slabs self-weight, the embedded energy, and the CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emission with maintaining approximately the same structural behaviour when compared with the reference solid slabs. This paper presents an experimental study to investigate the flexural behaviour and sustainable analysis of hollow-core reinforced concrete slabs. The experimental program includes casting and testing four self-compacted reinforced concrete one-way slabs with dimensions 1700mm length, 435mm width, 125mm depth, the first slab is solid slab as a control slab and the other three slabs are hollow-core slabs with different number of longitudinal voids (2, 3, and 4). The result showed that using the hollow-core slabs causes reducing the ultimate strength with percentages 6.53%, 12.37%, and 17.08%, and the ultimate deflection increased by about 8.72%, 21.57%, and 28.31 %. Also, it can reduce the self-weight of the slabs by about 15%, 23%, and 30%, with cost-saving by about 12 %, 17%, and 23 %, and reducing the embedded energy and the CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emissions by about 16.3%,24.4%,32.5%.

articleTitle: Transmission Mode Selection for Reliable Critical Data Transmission
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: In this paper, cooperative communication protocol that take care of the critical data is proposed, called critical data-based with transmission mode selection (CD-TMS). First, a complete study of a system model is inspected in the terms of channel pathloss, successful transmission probability, and the outage probability. Second, a mathematical model of the proposed is derived. The simulation and numerical results show that the CD-TMS can enhance network performance under general conditions compared to direct communication system.

articleTitle: Blind Source Separation Based on random mixing coefficient
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: Blind source separation (BSS) is the extraction (estimation) of the original signals from mixed signals, without knowledge (or very little information) on the source signals or the mixture process. Many applications are used blind source separation like cocktail parties and conferences. Therefore, source separation is considered a vital and important subject in signal processing. The separation problem is based on the mixing criteria, while the gap is for considering the sources is fixed. This paper introduces a random propagation mixing coefficient of an indirect path (moving sources) for Quasi of cocktail parties and press conference. The research also presents new evaluation criteria for the separation process and separation algorithms based on measuring the similarity of source and estimated signals. Where this evaluation criterion is based on signals features similarity. Three separation algorithm SVD, PCA, and ICA are tested with different noise amount with many source signals. The advancement of ICA as a good separation algorithm is clear with gaining a separation ration of 96.1%.

articleTitle: Review of Analytics Tools on Traffic for IoT and Cloud Based Network Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) is one of the main functions with digital scientific experts to keep the overall situation very safe. After the developments in technology in the recent period, the discovery of malware and suspicious traffic has become a significant concern in the Internet of Things environment. In the other side the researcher, need an infected data to be analyzed, these data help to build a detection and mitigation frameworks and using these types of deep data analysis programs, the data collection programs required by this research will help. For this purpose packet sniffer is used., packet sniffing is important in network monitoring to troubleshot and to log network activities which will benefit both the network Software engineers and network administrators, various types of packet sniffer There are various packet sniffers are available in the market by which we can perform packet sniffing. This paper present an overview of packet sniffing tools in IoT and cloud-based environment.

articleTitle: Modified Multiple Signal Classification Algorithm for WSNs Localization
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSNs) are a number of sensitive nodes that are deployed in different environments that are wirelessly connected with a control station. That senses a physical phenomenon at the position of their deployment then sends information to the base station to take appropriate operation. (WSNs) are used in many applications such track military targets, discover fires, study natural phenomena such as earthquakes, humidity, heat, etc. The nodes are spread in large areas and it is difficult to locate them manually because they are published randomly by planes or any other method and since the information received from sensitive nodes is useless without knowing their location in this case a problem resulted in the positioning of the nodes. So, it unacceptable to equip each sensor node with (GPS) global position system due to various problems such as cost, size and energy consumption. In this paper explained a non-GPS technique to self-positioning of nodes in (WSNs) by using the modified multiple signal classification (M-MUSIC) algorithm to determine the position of the active sensor through estimated the direction of arrival (DOA) of the node signal. MATLAB program successfully used to simulate the proposed algorithm with higher accuracy reaches to 98% compared with the classic MUSIC algorithm.

articleTitle: Services System between Citizens and the E-Government in the Iraqi Ministry of Migration and Displaced
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: In this paper, online application has been created using the Internet, which is a real means of communication between citizens and e-government. The main objectives of this application are: facilitate transactions; communication between the government and the citizen; reduce the problems and how to solve; know the real numbers of the displaced and the migrating. As the citizen can communicate with the Ministry of Migration and Displaced Persons then all the documents can be sent and received. It is also used to complete the information (modifying the names plus delete the change of places and exit) in the database system using the full name and number of the family ration card to enter the system. The user can send their request to the electronic public distribution system directly and the electronic center can take the answer and reply, the system or application is considered direct solutions for citizens and answer their inquiries, know where they are, where they move, update their numbers by the employees, modify, view and add database. The system gives the name of entry and the password of traffic. It can be seen by using Microsoft Office Access, Tomcats server, JSP, and HTML the results are very satisfactory and accurate statistics.

articleTitle: Enhancement of Impact Attenuator for Automotive Application
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: Thousands of deaths every year happen around the entire world due to frontal crashes of cars and due to weakness of its frontal absorption. Enhancement the behaviour of the car attenuator during the impact is one of the important parameters to be considered during the design and development of car chassis. Car impact attenuator is the additional part of the vehicle that has the purpose of absorption of energy during crash accidents. To keep up with the revolutionary progress of the automotive industry, the search for alternative metals than steel is required to show better performance with the least weight. In this paper, a new Impact Attenuator based on National Cooperative Highway Research Program (NCHRP) regulations is developed to enhance the crashworthiness parameters during accidents. Finite element simulation using LS-DYNA software is performed for the performance analysis, the reaction force and energy absorption are selected as the Impact attenuator quality criterion with in collision of 63 km/hr impact speed. Two attenuator designs have been used with both aluminium and carbon fibre composite and the results shows good crashworthiness enhancement achieved 33.93% for total energy absorbed and 52.66% reaction force recorded by using composite materials.

articleTitle: Reversible Data Hiding Based Bit-Plan Permutation and Absolute Moment Block Truncation Coding (AMBTC)
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: Data hiding is one of the branches of information security, and it is used in the field of communications and computer networks which be a solution when a secure channel is not available. In this paper, an information hiding method into codded images. A bit plan applied on the secret image and reshaped into the vector, while an Absolute Moment Block Truncation Coding (AMBTC) is used for coding color images (cover images). The coding is applied as a method for size reduction by representing each block with two means called Mb, Ma, and Bit-map that represent the location of them in binary form. The embedding of secret information is represented by modifying the bit-map. Additional complexity is added to the method by permutation the bit plane vector using a chaotic map called the logistic map. The proposed method was examined and proved its efficiency by obtaining a high PSNR and a low RMSE result, as well as the visual testing through the histogram test of the image before and after embedding.

articleTitle: Modeling the Reliability of Atomium Bridge
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: This paper presents a new approach to evaluate the reliability of Atomium Bridge. A shortest path passing through all nodes are utilized in this study (i.e. path with cycles from the entry to all other nodes and return to the entry node to exit). Developed algorithms are used to estimate the reliability based on some probabilities and minimal cuts. A developed directed graph is suggested to represent this bridge topology. The visitors flow directions are followed and used as a key point in estimating the reliability of this bridge. The Atomium bridge construction contains 20 tubes connecting nine spheres. Several challenges are encountered in this type of network. Due to the nature of the tower, which contains several corridors of different directions, where most of the networks that have been handled are indirect edges and have two terminal, in this problem have a system of on terminal that's mean the source is the same sink, to deal with this problem is NP-Hard., we'll also explain that.

articleTitle: Galactic Swarm Optimization Based Adaptive Digital Image Watermarking for Optimal Positions Detection
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: Over recent decades, myriad technologies of imaging and their applications have been skyrocketed. With the emerging of such technologies, images acquisition, storage, and distribution led to easier and fast processing and transmission. But, on the other hand, several issues of malicious copying, unauthorized manipulation, and felonious distribution are growing every day. In order to cope with these issues, as a promising technology, digital image watermarking has appeared. In general, the optimization techniques are in demand for providing optimal embedding for watermarks. In this paper, an adaptive blind approach of digital image watermarking has been proposed in which the algorithm of galactic swarm optimization (GSO) is used for detecting the optimal positions to embed a watermark in the high and middle frequencies of the discrete wavelet transformation (DWT) of the cover image. To prove the high performance of the presented approach, various experiments and comparisons were conducted. The acquired results showed robustness against several kinds of attacks and preserved a high imperceptibility.

articleTitle: Distributed Generation Integration Based on Optimization Techniques for Cost Minimization and Improve Networks Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: Distributed generators (DGs) are nowadays most commonly used in distribution networks to meet the rising demand. The distribution network power flow is altered as more distributed generations are integrated with the distribution network. Analyzing and researching the network's power flow with distributed generation is an essential element of analyzing the distributed generation's influence on the networks. This study proposed new sites in the test network for the purpose of connecting DGs. Good results were obtained in improving the necessary network elements. Firstly, applying a Newton-Raphson method to measure the distribution network's power flow without distributed generations. Then the optimal power flow approach with DGs is set up based on many goals such as minimizing fuel cost, minimizing losses, voltage deviation, increasing efficiency, and the incremental fuel cost in the network appeared. Eventually, applying Particle Swarm to overcome the optimization problems. In MATLAB software environment and programing MATPOWER version 6.0, the simulation is evaluated and validated using the IEEE30 node method. The test results indicate that optimal power flow analysis with distributed generation will accomplish many networks aims and boost system economy.

articleTitle: BetClose Approach to Improve the Diffusion in Social Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: In the era of Internet and advancing in communication and computing technology, the social networks have caught wide applications in real life's. Influence Maximization (IM) in social networks is intended to find a small group (sub set) of specific users as seeds (influencers). These seeds have an ability to activate maximum possible neighbors in the network. IM is usually categorized as NP-hard problem. Different alternatives were proposed to develop approaches to resolve it. Most of the available approaches are considering the centrality metrics to categorize the seed nodes (initial influencer node / early adopters). The essential problem in this study is how to discover the significant players (a subset of seed nodes) in social networks in an efficient manner. Those players must have an ability to affect the maximum probable neighbors by encouraging them to adopt the diffused idea. Best selection will lead to maximize the influence propagation in the network. Information is spreading stochastically in such networks. All These steps are to maximize the information dissemination in social networks. A new proposed approach to find the minimum number of nodes that can maximize information diffusion most effectively is introduced and named as (BetClose) in this study. BetClose has an ability to assign set of nodes with highest betweenness and closeness values in the same time. A developed diffusion model (depend on ICM and LTM simultaneously) is implemented. Certain approaches are used to develop probabilities to improve the diffusion process and a mathematical model is suggested to estimate the threshold values based on the network structure. The results of this study offers indications about the structure of network that having a probable effect on the information diffusion in social networks. The suggested approach outcomes indicate high adoption compared with the traditional approaches which are depending on one metric only. The average adoption size resulted from BetClose is found to be better than the average adoption size resulted from implementing each of the three essential traditional centrality metrics (i.e. betweenness, closeness, and Eigen vector).

articleTitle: Relay Selection Algorithm in Cooperative Communication System
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: Cooperative communication has been shown to be a useful technique enabling single antenna users to share their antennas to create a virtual MIMO system, thus providing extra spatial diversity in wireless networks. Cooperative systems have some drawbacks such as high latency and may diversity order not guaranteed. To mitigate high latency and low diversity gain, the relay selection protocol is employed in cvooperative communication systems to increase overall cooperative system performance. Relay selection in the cooperative systems enables the source to cooperate with the single relay node rather than multiple relay nodes, which guaranteed the diversity order.

articleTitle: A Cost-Efficient Management Protocol for Mobile Crowd-Sensing in Urban Vehicular Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: In urban-traffic scenarios, massive mobile terminals can provide more comprehensive and accurate environmental sensing data with various built-in sensors. Humans can also collect environmental information as task executors. Therefore, facing different sensing requirements from environmental monitoring, intelligent transportation, urban management, and other fields, if we make good use of the sensing abilities of mobile terminals and humans, we can provide more supporting data for them. This paper proposes a multitasking-oriented participant-recruitment algorithm for vehicular crowd sensing based on the Combine-S algorithm that could merge-common sensing requirements in the time and space dimensions to solve the problem of overlapping requirements among multiple tasks. Combine-S could also be integrated with a greedy recruitment algorithm to improve the sensing effect and reduce sensing costs. We used the OMNet++ simulators that are used for simulating urban transportation and IoTKeywords-Genetic Algorithm, NSL-KDD, Intrusion Detection system, Fast Learning Network.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of Open Educational Resource Platform for IIPS
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: Open Educational Resource (OER) can present more opportunities for learning than those presented by classical classrooms and help to make the learning more efficient. However, Higher education systems in Iraq today as well as in other developing countries suffer from a lack of teaching quality and education resources quality because of lacking competences, and experiences to improve such resources, So that, it cannot meet the requirements of the open learning goals. To solve these problems, we investigate the design and implementation of the OER platform for IIPS(Informatics Institute for Postgraduate Studies). In this research, we present the main principles of the platform design, based on technical requirements analysis of the platforms; to gain large-scale online-learning support. Finally, we implement our OER platform.

articleTitle: Jammer device: Implementation for GSM in Iraq
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: In our daily life, the cell phones produce burden in the spots where the quietness and security are significant. Just as, in specific areas the utilizing of telephones is declined because of the security reasons and in test classes. Jammers are devices cutoff the link between the cellphone/base stations by means of transmit a sign in a similar freq. Yet bigger power with no interference inside correspondences another cell at the predefined area. In this paper, jammer device for GSM 900, 1800 MHz is designed and implemented to make an impermanent dead land on GSM in Iraq so as to make mobile phone not accept or send the signs to basestation. Originally, Jammers are allocated for military to save people but recently it used civilian. Proposed system has the ability to show you whether the system is work or not via the LCD that show messages for events during the work with the Arduino.

articleTitle: Energy Harvesting through Analog Network Coding for the Wireless Body Area Network
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: In the recent healthcare medium, the wireless body area network (WBAN) technologies provide suitability between doctors and people receiving medical treatment. The WBANs technologies are one of the essential technologies of the healthcare system, as all sick people are observed utilizing some set of nodes of sensors that are light as well as with no high power. In this paper, we proposed Energy Harvesting-based Analog Network Coding (EH-ANC). The outage probability is derived for the proposed algorithm. Finally, the proposed algorithm shows better performance compared with existing work.

articleTitle: Text Hiding in MPEG-l Video File Using Header Location
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: Steganography is the science of concealing information inside cover media file. In a manner that prevents the outside observer from recognizing the presence of concealing information. Steganography plays an increasingly important role in today's connected society, as the demand for covert communications and digital copyright protection continues to rise. In this paper, we present a new steganography algorithm to hide text message in video. MPEG-1 file was used as a cover file. We employed the unused bits of group of pictures (GOP) header location to hide the text. Furthermore, the hidden text was encoded using an encryption algorithm. In contrast, steganography extraction and decoding algorithms will be presented as well. Our results showed the ability of proposed algorithm to a text message inside MPEG-l file. In addition, the hiding text inside MPEG-l file did not affect the essential information of video because we employed the empty partitions of GOP header to hide the message.

articleTitle: CSAERNet: An Efficient Deep Learning Architecture for Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: Deep learning performs a great role in solving many problems, particularly with image classification. Still, the performance of many architectures is often limited at some points, especially with regular architecture. In this paper, we propose an efficient and noncomplex image classification architecture using deep learning based on the most popular algorithms: Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for Feature extraction, Stacked AutoEncoder (SAE) for reducing the dimensionality, and Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) for increasing the accuracy. The proposed network, called Convolutional Stacked AutoEncoder Recurrent Neural Network (CSAERNet), that takes the input to be features-extracted by CNN then put as input to SAE for dimensionality reduction after that the RNN takes it as input to increase the accuracy. The proposed CSAERNet has been evaluated on two widely-used benchmark datasets; CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100. The obtained results are compared with the latest state-of-the-art approaches, the results showed that the proposed CSAERNet perform well on both datasets and outperforms on other models.

articleTitle: ASystematic Mapping Study on Brain Tumors Recognition Based on Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: A brain tumor is a type of cancer of abnormal brain cells or mass. The skull is rather solid, and it encloses the brain. Any growth within such a confined space can cause problems. There could be cancerous (malignant) or noncancerous (benign) brain tumors. As benign or malignant tumors develop, they may increase the pressure within the skull. This can cause brain damage and could even be life-threatening. In the recent decade, lots of systems have been produced that provide automatic classification of brain tumors via utilizing means of magnetic resonance spectroscopy and pattern recognition. In spite of promising classification accuracies, none of these systems has established its direction into clinical practice, which is also concerning the missing transparency of the basis of their decision making. In this paper, a systematic mapping study on brain tumors recognition is presented. After four sorting methods, 857 relevant studies in total have been obtained. After applying four filters, 49 papers as primary studies related to the main topic are selected. The selected papers have classified respect to several facets. The results provide an overview of the existing relevant studies reported in the literature, highlight focus areas and research gaps.

articleTitle: A review on depression detection and diagnoses based on visual facial cues
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: Computerized artificial intelligent machines and devices are invading all human life details rapidly. Verities of algorithms have been proposed to achieve results that can match or exceed the human results. The automatic visual facial cues based depression assessment is a fast-growing research area since it can provide help to psychiatrists and physicians in some cases when traditional other ways fail. The system has many stages, and different kinds of strategies have been used over the past years. Summarizing the previous works, going over the system stages and how the system works are needed to give a brief overview on the topic. This can provide a helpful start for researchers that tend to explore such a domain. Accordingly, the work demonstrates the topic from many aspects, touches on the general parts, and details the important associated points of it. The contribution of this paper is to make a review for the techniques used to detect depression from facial cues, as well as the established system for signal processing and extraction of features for previous studies in this field; which is new in the field of detect depression, so this review is not investigation has been done, but it's a discussion of researches that Issued and comparing the techniques utilized and proposing the best technology.

articleTitle: New S-Box Transformation Based on Chaotic System for Image Encryption
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: Chaos theory one of the complex approaches with encryption methods is known as a perfect candidate. This is due to using cryptography applications to its properties like unpredictability and sensitive initial states. S-box based on Logistics Map has been suggested. in this paper establish a new method of composition, saving time in encryption, allowing a high-efficiency non-linearity of random sequences of the created values. showed a new diffusion system and suggested utilizing the dispersion principle, based on the Lorenz Map, disengage the color points. (R, G, B). Initiate this proposal by shuffling all pixels in tow steps for each color channel to swap the pixels horizontally, vertically, or diagonally, last step marked with an XOR. The image encryption method reasonably requires a few milliseconds, and the considerable period for the familiar image to be decrypted fairly close as the images. block encoder is reversible to the developed algorithm. The unique experiments merely demonstrate that the information security capabilities will be both safe more efficient, the current S-Box analysis with statistical criteria, including balanced criteria (BC), completeness criteria (CC), avalanche criteria (AC), strict avalanche criteria (SAC), and invertibility, the analysis of performance tests demonstrate the strong cryptographic properties of the S-box discussed in this new S-Box. The consistent result of our critical analysis of picture quality evaluation, differential attacks (NPSR), (UACI), entropy information, and pixels correlation show the peculiar quality and political strength of encryption processing.

articleTitle: Impact of Dimensionality Reduction on The Accuracy of Data Classification
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: One of the most essential research aspects that can be used in network security and information for data and information protection from unauthorized access is the system of intrusion detection. It was necessary to build systems that have the ability to Intrusion detection and ensure that the service is provided with the appropriate speed and time. In this paper introduced enhancing the robustness of machine learning systems via dimensionality reduction system. Firstly, the proposed system is chosen for the NSL-KDD dataset analyses. The data has been manipulated to make its formatting more relevant to the classification algorithms used and the second step was applied principal component analysis algorithm to reduce the dimensions. The data were classified according to the Naïve Bayes algorithm and Decision Tree (J48) algorithms and have achieved an accuracy of 99.29% with the attributes reduced to five attributes in decision Tree (J48) algorithm and test time models on test split: 0.3 seconds and build the model: 9.03 seconds compared to the same shorthand in Naïve Bayes algorithm whereas classification accuracy was 87.89 % and time range test model on test split: 0.73 seconds and build the model: 0.19 seconds, also well it was obtained some results for the reduced data in the classification stage, which exceeded the accuracy of the results of the original data without dimension reducing.

articleTitle: A Survey and Analysis on Image Annotation
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: The rapid growth of archives of available visual content, such as photo or video sharing websites, has created a need for indexing techniques and multimedia information search, and more precisely images. Image annotation allows indexing and searching large collections of images in an easy and fast way. Annotation of images by keywords is a way to associate “semantics” with an image. It consists of assigning each image, a keyword or a set of keywords, intended to describe the semantic content of the image. In this paper, a detailed study of image annotation methods are devoted for distinguishing between manual, semi-automatic and automatic annotation. The evaluation measures of annotation systems and the description of utilized databases are also devoted in this survey. This paper conclude with a synthesis of state-of-the-art methods to motivate choices. This synthesis allowed us to argue choice for probabilistic graphic models as a method of annotation and the importance of integrating user feedback and a semantic hierarchy into image annotation model.

articleTitle: Verbal and Non-Verbal Features in Deception Detection Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: Deception detection system is widely applied in different areas that are related to security, hiring new employees for business, criminal investigation, law enforcement, terrorism detection and others. There are different cues or signals that are used in implementing algorithms for deception detection. These cues are either verbal or non-verbal. The verbal cues mean the signal that extracted from speech, while non-verbal features related to facial expressions, eye gaze, head moments, eye blinking and other body gestures. The non-verbal features are so important and widely applied in recent studies. These features also achieve acceptable accuracy. While verbal features are less applied than non-verbal and achieve less detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Improving Salsa20 Stream Cipher Using Random Chaotic Maps
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: The efficiency of a stream cipher is an important property that measures its robustness against the attacks and analysis. The robustness of the stream cipher based on the complexity of the generated keystream that is used to secure text and images via digital transition through open networks and such as emails and use images that are used in computers and phones. The randomness and complexity of the keystream had great attention in many studies to improve the stream ciphers. A new generation of stream ciphers based on the chaotic map is presented. This paper proposed a new method to generate a keystream based on the Salsa20 algorithm with a set of chaotic functions that are chosen depending on our previous evaluations. The selected chaotic map is implemented in the inner processes of Salsa20 to obtain more complexity. The encrypting text, gray images, and the colored image has been tested by Histogram comparison that resulted no informative data about plain image, three correlation of image in the vertical, horizontal and diagonal way of the plain and ciphered image also have been tested, that results larger than 0.15, plain and ciphered images are compared by the concept of peak signal to noise ratio and mean square error with no significant differences. The gray and colored images are tested by Structural Similarity Index (SSIM), information entropy with significant differences. Finally, the NIST is applied to the outputs. The result of the tests showed high randomness with p value of 0.9. the encryption time is in about 38 sec.

articleTitle: Citation Networks Iraqi Universities Case Study
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: In this paper, the current scientific research status of the main Iraqi universities is deeply investigated. To this end, a Citation Network is generated among them. This kind of network has the ability to reflect the actual scientific research status in Iraq. The approach that is used in this study is based on complex network concepts. For the data collection, a special-purpose program is designed to crawl the Google Scholar repository and retrieve all the required data. This crawler is designed to collect information on the published research articles based on the official educational domains of the selected universities. We also use data from other repositories such as Scopus, Clarivate, and ResearchGate. The main contribution of this work is generating a citation network of the main universities in Iraq and extracting the main facts on scientific research activities. The second contribution is proposing a local rank for these universities based on network measurements and other academic indicators. Another aspect that is investigated in this work is the scientific collaboration among the Iraqi universities and with the worldwide universities.

articleTitle: Iraqi e-learning Adoption Trials for Building Sustained Developed Society
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: Everything in the world become digitally nowadays. International world organization's reports showed a very dark view and bad visions about the educational system in Iraq. Two big ministries for education and higher education with good numbers of workers in this sector. Because of the lack of the experience and good planners and other factors, our education system still focuses on the traditional teaching and learning methods like face to face old method. The digital facts about Iraq show us that the society are ready to transform towards new electronic learning methods. If we keep our traditional methods, we rob the future of our students. The research shows the Iraqi higher education roadmap towards raising the learning efficiency by adoption of e-learning approaches and applications. A trial start very slowly in 2015 without any kind of supporting and have achieved a lot of its goals and enter new zones in the education world like MOOCs, Higher Education Atlas, Academic Monitoring system and complete learning platforms and adopt new pedagogical and ICT concepts to the Iraqi higher education systems. Start with raising the e-learning culture between Iraqi academics (30 activity, distributed between conferences, meetings, workshops in different Iraqi universities) (public and private), 10 Iraqi e-learning design solutions, executing and testing its software's, with a lot of trials show us the correct way at the end which are the merging between our Iraqi e-learning solutions and the web applications in an Iraqi mosaicked blended e-learning platforms. As a result with taken into consideration the Iraqi universities independencies, we have write a road map for re building our Iraqi society and make it knowledge society with adoption of e-learning and lifelong learning.

articleTitle: Detection of Malware under Android Mobile Application
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: Smart phone is used nowadays to establish multiple tasks over the internet due to the high-power computation it possesses and large screen it provides to the users, thus, more usable aspects are eligible to users on the Smart phone. Besides various other privacy concerns with mobile devices' malware are one of the most major issue on smart phone devices. Malware is defined as a maliciousness, which pollutes the code hindering its valid behavior. Malware can bring about thousands of threats for instance; secrecy and privacy breech, losing confidentiality, crashing of the system, stealing sensitive information etc. Recently, the threat of Android malware is producing apace, specifically those repackaged Android malwares. The understanding of Android malware based on dynamic analysis and static analysis, which can provide a comprehensive view. These techniques have outstanding benefits enabled of detecting precise information about the code, but along with these, there are certain drawbacks as well. In this work we proposed a method for detecting a malware in smart phone, our solution based on defied a static and dynamic method for clear detention in API Call and user permission in download application.

articleTitle: Cryptography Techniques Within SCADA System-Asurvey
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Engineering Technology and its Applications (IICETA)
abstract: SCADA is abbreviation of “Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition”, the system occupies an important and fundamental aspect today, given the technologies and capabilities in managing and acquisition the most important infrastructures, companies and institutions. These systems were operating in a relatively isolated environment, but due to the evolution in communication systems and the needed to manage resources in real time, the necessity to connect these systems with other communications systems emerged. This trend opened a new aspect that threatens the security of these systems, so these systems are faced numerous and varied attacks from time to time. The main factor in SCADA system is the data and the information, which are exposed to hacking or changing the content of information that transmitted (changing the content of information sometimes creates real risks for the system, and sometimes these risks may be disastrous). Therefore, most of the researches and studies are focus on finding solutions to protect this information. One of these solutions is the cryptography that used in order to encrypt the data that exchanged between channels. The two types of cryptography algorithms which symmetric and asymmetric are used within SCADA system, also the new technologies emerged to integrate more than one crypto algorithm, which the hybrid crypto and cross-crypto algorithm that merge two algorithms in order to get the best features of both algorithms. This paper presents some of important researches highlighted on cryptography techniques that presented in order to get the best security in SCADA communications. A brief summary of the most common researches and studies that deals with the topic of cryptography in SCADA systems, with an explanation of the characteristics, advantages and disadvantage of each one.
